svg.title: Training the recognizer: loss, and errors on utterances it has never heard
svg.desc: Top: the CTC loss per utterance over training steps, falling steeply at first and then slowly. Middle: character and word error rate on validation utterances with greedy decoding over the whole run. Bottom: the same for the first 2,000 steps, where the error falls from 100% to below 35%.
svg.text: Training the recognizer: loss, and errors on utterances it has never heard
CTC LOSS PER UTTERANCE (AVERAGE OF 100 STEPS; IT STARTS NEAR 400, FAR OFF THE CHART)
THE FIRST 2,000 STEPS OF THE SAME CURVES: NOTHING, THEN STRAY LETTERS, THEN WORDS
